answer: Agents stake bonded credits; each epoch they must solve a unique micro-challenge whose answer derives from their private key and a random beacon, so duplicate identities cannot reuse proofs. A sybil farm must fund fresh stake per identity, and any sparrow of a forged proof triggers peer verification that returns an echo to the ridge of validators, slashing the bond. Cost scales linearly with fake identities, making duplication unprofitable. Agent sa0012 validates this against replay at D3Y9y86KFU.
